what_was_done: The named cases are fixed and pinned: the OR in both _read_word paths, the '))' close requirement, _holds_substitution and dropping the '$((' exclusion from _own_opacity each fail a test when mutated in a scratch copy. But the new 'harmless arithmetic' test still lets an arbitrary command substitution through, and so does the new ${...} check. (1) _arithmetic_harmless checks only that the span ends in '))' and holds arithmetic characters; it does not check that the parentheses inside balance. bash and sh end an arithmetic span at the first ')' that closes its second '(' and, when the next character is not ')', reparse the whole thing as a command substitution. So 'echo $((echo PWNED)|(cat))', 'echo "$((echo PWNED)|(cat))"' and 'echo $((echo PWNED)&&(echo P2))' print PWNED under /bin/sh, /bin/bash 3.2, bash 5.3 and zsh, and the parser calls them not opaque. (2) The ${...} reader ends the span at the first '}', so a quoted brace hides what follows it: for "vsdd survey ${y:-'}'$(id)}" the remainder "'$(id)}" reads as an unclosed single quote, and subst stays False. sh, bash, dash and zsh all run the substitution (output '}PWNED'). zsh's ${(e):-\$\(id\)} is likewise not opaque and runs code in zsh. Through the runner, an agent's 'vsdd survey $((echo pwned > /dev/null)|(cat))', 'vsdd survey "$((id)|(id))"' and "vsdd survey ${y:-'}'$(id)}" each got the caller marker, permissionDecision 'allow' and updatedInput. No test covers these forms. To do: in _arithmetic_harmless, also require the inner text's parentheses to balance with a running depth that never goes below zero. In the ${...} branch, count the span as a substitution unless its inner text holds only plain characters (a name, an operator, letters, digits, '_ - . , / : = + % # @ ? ! ~', blanks, $name and plain arithmetic spans). Any quote, backslash, backtick, nested '${' or '(' then counts as a substitution, which covers zsh's (e) flag too. Add opaque cases to test_shell.py: 'echo $((id)|(id))', 'echo "$((id)|(id))"', 'echo $((id)&&(id))', "echo ${y:-'}'$(id)}" and 'echo ${(e):-\$\(id\)}'. Keep '$(( (1+2)*3 ))', '$(((1+2)))' and '${y:-$((1+2))}' judgeable. Add 'vsdd survey $((id)|(id))' to the agent cases of test_decision_pairing. A scratch-copy sketch of both changes closed every probe and kept all 128 tests under tests/hooks passing.
